description: Defines the 'TranscribeCommand' structure implementing a command-line interface to transcribe media files using speech recognition. It manages input arguments, configures transcription options, performs transcription asynchronously, and outputs the result.

classes.name: TranscribeCommand
classes.description: A command-line utility to transcribe media files using speech recognition, with configurable options for locale, output format, and content censorship.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the transcription process asynchronously, reading the input file, running speech analysis, aggregating the results, and writing or printing the transcript.
